title: Landscape Architecture, B.L.A. (College of Arts and Architecture)
notes: The second 5-year professional program built this session (9 semesters, 139 total credits, spanning Fall Year 1 through Fall Year 5 -- unlike Architecture B.Arch's 10-semester/Spring-Y5 finish, this program's own suggested plan ends in the Fall of Year 5, with no Spring Year 5 term). Requires grad_years=5. New larch_catalog.json created for the entire LARCH department (26 courses). Real engine-mechanics gap (same pattern as Architecture B.Arch): the bulletin lists several LARCH course pairs as mutual corequisites of each other (LARCH 115/155, LARCH 116/156, LARCH 215/255, LARCH 216/256) -- broken into one-directional edges since the engine's same-term scheduling can't resolve true mutual concurrency; both courses in each pair are still scheduled in the same semester regardless. LARCH 414 (5-15cr, repeatable) is scheduled 3 times (Semesters 6, 8, 9) -- the first is a literal course pick, the other two are generic repeat slots, matching the ARCH 491/GD 495 repeatable-course convention. Semester 2's own credit total (17, per the bulletin's own header) didn't reconcile against its itemized course list (which only summed to 14) -- added a third generic Gen Ed slot to close the 3-credit gap; the resulting 9-semester total (139 credits) now exactly matches the bulletin's stated program total, confirming this was a fair reconciliation rather than a guess. Entrance to Major (a portfolio-based application review) and the required semester abroad (Semester 7, LARCH 499A/B/D) are noted but not modeled as enforced gates beyond their real course-code prereqs, matching convention for standing/application-based requirements elsewhere in this session. 2026-08-27 re-verification against the CURRENT live bulletin (via its own 'Suggested Academic Plan' tab HTML): Semester 8 (Fourth Year Spring) had its final item labeled 'Elective' (3cr), but the real bulletin's Fourth Year Spring row is LARCH 414(5) + LARCH 424(3) + three plain 'General Education Course' items (3cr each) -- no elective at all in that term; the 'Elective' the real plan does list appears only once, in Semester 9 (Fifth Year Fall), which this plan already modeled correctly. Fixed Semester 8's mislabeled item to a third GEN ED slot.
